summary: Completed backend + frontend verification for PCStore attachment proxy contract using mocked upstream image responses and live admin UI checks. Found one backend security-handling defect for malformed absolute URLs.

critical.issue: Malformed absolute URLs such as 'https://[::1' raise ValueError from urlsplit instead of returning a controlled HTTPException (safe 4xx rejection).

action_items: Wrap URL parsing in _normalise_pcstore_attachment_url with safe exception handling so malformed URLs always return HTTPException 400.
Keep current strict checks (exact HTTPS origin, traversal/path/fragment rejection, no redirects, bounded image content).
MOCKED: Browser image responses were intercepted at the PCAdmin proxy route; no live PCStore image fetch was performed.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py support/proxy logic still resides in a very large monolith (>5k LOC), increasing risk of security regressions; consider extracting support attachment proxy logic into dedicated module + unit tests.
Malformed URL parsing path currently leaks parser-level ValueError (internal exception type) instead of controlled API error semantics.
seed_data_creation: Created temporary support fixture via /app/scripts/create_support_fixture_iteration63.py and removed it via /app/scripts/cleanup_support_fixture_iteration63.py after UI validation.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend verified in live admin session (qa account) that thumbnail src, lightbox image src, thread download href, and lightbox download href all use /api/support/tickets/{ticket}/messages/{message}/attachments/{index}/image and include ?download=true for downloads; proxy image requests were intercepted and mocked in browser (3 intercepted requests). Backend test suite now includes expanded security/upstream validation coverage and currently fails only malformed URL exception handling.
rca of the issue: RCA: _normalise_pcstore_attachment_url directly calls urllib.parse.urlsplit(value) without guarding parser exceptions. Repro: run pytest test_attachment_proxy_malformed_url_is_rejected_as_http_exception with input 'https://[::1'. Observed: ValueError('Invalid IPv6 URL') bubbles up. Expected: HTTPException(400, 'Invalid ticket attachment URL'). Mitigation: catch ValueError (and similar parser errors) around urlsplit for both base and candidate URLs, then raise HTTPException 400 with existing invalid-url detail.
